items.title: Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2013
items.q: Yeah, Steve Yao did. Professor Steve Yao.

ctx.x: Well this has been fascinating, once again. And I wish you the best of luck with your concert on Friday, and as a pianist and composer and thinker — and I think you called yourself a “cultural entrepreneur?”
Yeah, Steve Yao did. Professor Steve Yao.
